CLAIMID / INLINE COURTS — source ACK. I did not re-run scout's two builds.

PERMITS, current main:
- NarrativeCompilerInput.of compares Inline to the ledger only when evidence already has that id (compiler.scala:512-515). Two Inlines, one new EvidenceId, no ledger row: the foreach never compares them to each other. Court 1 is open.
- Materialized ClaimId hashes evidence ID strings, not content (compiler.scala:1310-1318: digest of evs.map(_.id.value).sorted). resolveEvidence returns Inline as-is (:1342). Same id, different spans, same ClaimId. Court 2 is the named class, on main.

R11 therefore has to run before claim construction, not only inside collect. No implementation. PRD draft 2 is in review; I am not acking the whole document. 4e08df70 still waiting.
